tips.li: Mechs can adapt to EMP damage. Don't use it too much!
Traders usually keep their stash on their pack animals.
Generators produce a lot of heat--sometimes enough to give a colonist heatstroke.
Not all colonists need limbs. If needed, feel free to remove them.
Colonists can carry some medicine on them. This can be a lifesaver in tough moments.
Mountains can provide a shelter against heat and heatwaves.
Predators will not hunt a colonist that goes indoors.
The higher the quality of the bed, the faster people using it sleep.
People don't use all their organs. Removing unnecessary ones could turn a profit.
Many colonists can be researching at once, as long as each has a place to do so.
Human skin is a plentiful textile that can be used for many things, from couches to hats.
Doors held open will not slow movement, but they also let temperature equalize between rooms.
Most colonists hate seeing corpses. Keep your kill zones away from living areas.
Sleeping outdoors is a negative experience for most colonists. Even a basic shack is better than nothing.
As your pawn's expectations grow, so does the need for more types of recreation.
Solar panels don't work at night or during eclipses. Always have backup power.
Power switches can isolate parts of your power network to prevent total grid failure.
Enemies target weak points. Thin walls and open doors invite raids.
Opening doors frequently lets heat escape. Airlocks help maintain temperature.
Some animals bond with colonists, increasing mood but causing grief if they die.
Animals can haul items if trained, reducing colonist workload.
Darkness makes colonists slower and more unhappy.
You can right-click the allow order to allow everything on the tile.
Long walking distances can waste more time than slow work speeds. Layout is often the determining factor of a workspace.
Items deteriorate quickly outdoors. Roof your storage or lose value fast.
People choose the fastest path, not the shortest. Floor types may influence routes.
Scars permanently reduce body part efficiency unless treated.
Overbulking your settlement early can attract more danger than you're ready for.
Large rooms take significantly longer to heat or cool than small ones.
You can press the 'Z' key to search your surroundings for specific things.
